chunks: If you see the believer whose gaze has become fixed, whose left eye has flowed with tears, whose forehead has perspired, whose lips have contracted, and whose nostrils have widened, then whichever of that you see, it is sufficient for you by it.

key_terms.شَخَصَ بِبَصَرِهِ: his gaze became fixed or stared upward
key_terms.فَحَسْبُكَ بِهِ: that is sufficient for you as an indicator

ai.seo_question: What signs indicate that a believer is at the point of passing away according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes physical signs by which the approach of a believer's passing may be recognized. In the context of the chapter on washing the deceased, it serves as guidance for identifying the state near death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.362 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you see a believer whose eyes are fixed, the left eye tears up, the forehead perspires, the lips contract, and the nostrils widen, then that is sufficient for you (as a sign of their passing)."
